executive_summary: TPC Scottsdale rewards precision iron play and putting, making Scottie Scheffler the standout play despite +225 odds - our model gives him a massive 26.0% win probability with elite approach play (+1.30 SG) and putting (+0.56 SG). Value hunters should target Maverick McNealy at +3300, who ranks 9th in total strokes gained (+1.25) with strong recent course form (T9 in 2025, T6 in 2024) and positive course fit (+0.045). Among longshots, Harry Hall at +5200 offers compelling upside as the field's top putter (+0.72 SG) with a 14.2% top-10 probability.

insights.title: Scheffler Massive Model Edge
